effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.activate adds no "Polymerization", it reveals the Deck to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. Neither lineage text mentions a reveal.

changes.historical_text: Add 1 "Polymerization" from your Deck to your hand.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.target returns true unconditionally where the modern script requires Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...), so the Spell can be activated with no "Polymerization" left in the Deck. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: ERA TEXT MISMATCH: the GOAT variant's cdb text is an exact match for lineage v1 (LCKC-EN089, Legendary Collection Kaiba Mega Pack, 2018-03-08) - i.e. the modern text - not for v0 (TP6-EN003, Tournament Pack 6, 2005-06-01), which was the text in force across both target eras. The difference is cosmetic only (v0's "1 \"Polymerization\" card" and its trailing "Then shuffle your Deck." procedural sentence), so no behaviour is affected; the flag records that the variant displays a post-era printing's wording. The chain is started at v1 per the rule that it begins where the baseline implementation's text points, which is why this record carries no separate cosmetic change entry. Separately noted: the card's earliest TCG printing (2005-06-01) postdates the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot; that is a pool question, not a text question, and is left to the format definition. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
